name: GDLM 63 dual and movers lab
desc: A test course: play once in practice mode with hitboxes on. Dual mode (1-3) and moving objects (4-8). At 6, 7 and 8, do not jump.

lab.name: dual cube
lab.note: sim: player 2 rides upside down with its top at y 300 (10 blocks); one press jumps both, mirrored

lab.name: dual gravity portal
lab.note: sim: player 1 goes to the roof, player 2 to the floor (both flip)

lab.name: solo portal
lab.note: sim: the floor player stays (GD keeps whoever touched it); if the run ends on the roof, GD kept player 1

lab.name: rising platform
lab.note: sim: the cube rides the block up 60 units in 1 s

lab.name: move to target
lab.note: sim: the spike lands on the marker at the floor (jump it)

lab.name: pause / resume
lab.note: sim: the spike stops ~38 units up (pause after ~0.19 s of 0.6 s) until the resume after the player; without the pause it is 120 up

lab.name: multi-trigger loop
lab.note: sim: the spike is 60 up when the cube passes (3 loops); fired once it would be 20 up and kill

lab.name: toggled-off trigger
lab.note: sim: the move never fires, the spike stays 5 blocks up; if it drops to the floor, GD fires triggers in a disabled group
